name: Crossbow Champion (Scout Archetype)
body:
The crossbow is an under-loved weapon. In the right hands it becomes a formidable and versatile tool.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

The crossbow champion is proficient in all crossbows, including exotic versions, but does not gain proficiency in handaxe, throwing axe, battleaxe, light hammer, longbow, and shortbow, nor the composite longbows and short bows. This alters the crossbow champion’s normal weapon proficiencies.

Rapid Reload (Ex)

The crossbow champion gains Rapid Reload as a bonus feat except that it applies to all crossbows rather than a single type.

Deeds (Ex)

A crossbow champion gains the following deeds in exchange for other deeds normally gained by the scout.

Crossbow Sniper (Ex)

As long as the crossbow champion has at least 1 grit point they add their Dexterity bonus to damage rolls with crossbows against targets within 30 ft. They may spend 1 grit point as a swift action to increase this bonus damage to double their Dexterity modifier on their next attack. This deed replaces the lucky break deed normally gained at 1st level.

Subtle Sharpshooter (Ex)

As long as the crossbow champion has at least 1 grit point they do not provoke attacks of opportunity for reloading or firing a crossbow in melee. This deed replaces the kip-up deed normally gained at 3rd level.

Shattershot (Ex)

When making an attack roll the crossbow champion may spend 1 grit point to reduce their target’s defenses. The crossbow champion chooses armor, natural armor, or DR. If the attack hits it reduces the chosen defense by an amount equal to the crossbow champion’s Wisdom modifier. By spending 2 grit points the crossbow champion can instead reduce the chosen defense by twice their Wisdom modifier. This reduction lasts for a number of rounds equal to the crossbow champion’s Wisdom modifier and does not stack, though it can be applied to multiple defense types. At 11th level the crossbow champion can instead choose to reduce energy resistance and at 15th level they can choose to reduce spell resistance. This deed replaces the sudden strike gained at 7th level.

Easy Reload (Su)

As long as the crossbow champion has at least 1 grit, reloading any crossbow is a free action and any crossbow wielded by the crossbow champion is treated as though it had the endless ammunition magic weapon property. This deed replaces the combat acumen deed normally gained at 11th level.

Fletcher (Su)

At 6th level the crossbow champion gains Craft Magic Arms and Armor as a bonus feat without meeting its prerequisites but they may only craft magical crossbows and crossbow bolts with this feat, using their crossbow champion level as the caster level for any item crafted. Instead of making a Spellcraft check to craft the item the crossbow champion may use a Craft or Profession skill related to bow-craft. This ability replaces the bonus combat feat normally gained at 6th level.

Binding Bolt (Ex or Su)

At 12th level, the crossbow champion may make a special attack with their crossbow as a standard action. If the attack hits, it deals damage normally and the target is pinned to the ground, wall, or other nearby obstacle. The target is treated as entangled and unable to move from their square unless they take a standard action on their turn to free themselves. The crossbow champion can spend 2 grit points to add the effects of a dimensional anchor to this attack using their class level as the caster level.

When imbued with this effect the bolt is considered a force effect and can thus damage incorporeal creatures normally. This attack can be combined with Vital Strike and its later iterations. This ability replaces the bonus combat feat normally gained at 12th level.
